neighbours.label: an on-screen interface element appearing, moving or being located on a display (controls sliding up, an icon appearing, waiting for an element's presence); the same verbs about physical objects off-screen stay low
fire: Swipe down from the top edge and the quick settings panel slides into view on the screen.
When the download finishes, a green checkmark appears next to the file name in the window.
Hover over the chart and a small tooltip pops up showing the exact value on the screen.
Press the home button twice and the recent apps menu slides up from the bottom of the display.
If the battery runs low, a red warning icon appears in the corner of the screen.
Right-click the desktop and a context menu opens beside the cursor on the monitor.
Once the video starts, the playback toolbar fades out from the bottom of the screen.
quiet: Lift the lid on the cooler and a cloud of cold air drifts out over the picnic blanket.
When the bread finishes baking, a golden crust forms on top of the loaf in the oven.
Walk past the hedge and a small rabbit pops out from under the bushes in the yard.
Press the pedal twice and the old bicycle chain slides back onto the rear gear.
If the tank runs low, the farmer refills it from the well behind the barn.
Open the front door and the smell of fresh coffee drifts into the hallway.
Once the concert starts, the crowd slowly moves toward the front of the stage.

notes: Card: top examples are UI/GUI contexts (popup, controls at the bottom of the screen, a graphic appears on the screen, visibility_of_element_located). Probe: 'playback controls slide up from the bottom of the screen' 0.611, 'presence_of_element_located' 0.453, 'a small icon appears on the screen' 0.334, 'notification banner pops up' 0.208; garden pond 0.007, mint sprig on dessert 0.008.
